title: PRD-08 Roch mountain line (opens 2027)
summary: Cost centre PRD-08 for the Roch mountain line, planned to open in 2027 under manufacturing unit NBC-MAN-01.
body:
Cost centre PRD-08 represents the Roch mountain line production facility scheduled to open in 2027 [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, the cost centre is assigned to operating unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. Its operational status in the financial records is PLANNED [^r1].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Cost centre code | PRD-08 [^r1] |
| Description | Roch mountain line (opens 2027) [^r1] |
| Operating unit | NBC-MAN-01 [^r1] |
| Owner | DOKAFOR [^r1] |
| Status | PLANNED [^r1] |

## Record

In the FY2026-27 accounts, PRD-08 is listed within master data for manufacturing cost centres under unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. It remains in PLANNED status pending line commissioning in 2027 under manager DOKAFOR [^r1]. Detailed budget allocations and master records are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1].
